## Important Note

* **This mod need** [**Old VFX Base Mod**](https://runeforge.dev/mods/eeebe09e-b838-49fb-b2ef-93cb3aa743a9 "Old Yasuo VFX Base Mod") **to fully working**.
  If you encounter any problems during installation, please contact me or join RuneForge Discord.

## Skin information

* Champion Replaced: Yasuo
* Skin Replaced: Default
* Original author: Sakuraの樱
* Re-Uploaded by: The Melancholy Of Slime

## Specifications

* Re-Uploaded with Old Yasuo VFX
* New model and texture
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* Modified particles

## Known issues

* The model’s weighting isn’t perfect so it might have some issues regarding some animations.

## Disclaimer

I am not the original author of this skin, I only updated it so it works again as a custom skin for League of Legends.
The original author is Sakuraの樱. If the original author wants this skin to be taken down, I will take it down again.
You can contact me here: Victorious#9216
